name: Utagai Nijisuke
source:
A mysterious boy whom the protagonist meets during her time at school. He is quite affable, but there seems to be something strange about him. Can be seen near the school sometimes.

‘Yup, that’s a good name! I’m the one who said it, so there’s no doubt about it.’
‘It’s not that things are precious because they have meaning, it’s the search for meaning itself that brings value.’

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
